findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_perp_market_history" is 638 chars, far longer than this server's median (111). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "get_price_indicators" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
